title: Custom eggless cakes near Rosehill and Camellia — open until 10pm daily
summary:
Order a custom eggless cake from Rosehill or Camellia and still need to collect it after a six o'clock finish in Parramatta? Most bakeries are shut by then. Harris Park isn't — we're open until 10pm, every day.

100% eggless since 2019. Not some cakes — every cake, all 15 flavours, six sizes, finished in buttercream, fondant or ganache. Send a photo of the design and we build it from there.

48 hours minimum notice on every order. That's what fresh baking actually takes. The 10pm close just means the notice period is the only wait — not the pickup window too.

WhatsApp +61 425 697 725. Shop 1, 96–98 Wigram Street, Harris Park, serving Rosehill and Camellia too.
